description: This Python source file provides utility functions for checking permissions and authorization related to vector store endpoints in a FastAPI application. It includes functions for matching endpoints, verifying permissions based on API key metadata, and determining if a user is allowed to access specific vector store or file endpoints.

methods.name: bool _does_endpoint_match(endpoint_path: str, request_path: str)
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint path matches the request path, accounting for path parameters.

methods.name: bool check_vector_store_permission( index_name: str, permission: str, key_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], team_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Verifies if the provided API key and team metadata permit access to a specific vector store index with the required permission.

methods.name: Optional[Literal[True]] is_allowed_to_call_vector_store_endpoint( provider: LlmProviders, index_name: str, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Determines if a user (via API key) has permission to call a vector store endpoint based on provider configuration and user role.

methods.name: Optional[Literal[True]] is_allowed_to_call_vector_store_files_endpoint( provider: LlmProviders, vector_store_id: str, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to call a vector store files endpoint, similar to above, but specific to file endpoints.
